item.title: Seychelles pushes cruise tourism toward higher value, lower impact
item.description: Seychelles is steering its cruise-tourism strategy toward higher-value visits, local business participation and managed environmental impact.

item.title: Mauritius Telecom and Cassava sign AI partnership MoU

item.title: Michel Zecler trial examines violence and police reports
item.description: A French court is examining the 2020 arrest of Michel Zecler, disputed police accounts and video evidence.

item.title: Trinidad and Tobago says it is not negotiating to receive US third-country deportees
item.description: Trinidad and Tobago's government says it is not negotiating to receive US-deported third-country nationals.

item.title: Analysis: Africa’s conflict-prevention gap is action after warning
item.description: Opinion: Prof. Adeoye O. Akinola argues that African conflict prevention depends on acting on early-warning signals.
